title: Canonicalize sparse tensor scalar identity
finding: SparseTensorEntry already refused bools, strings and non-int/float objects and rejected non-finite values, but IEEE-754 negative zero survived float conversion. Python canonical JSON preserves the -0.0 spelling, so numerically equivalent +0.0 and -0.0 tensor claims could retain different serialized bytes and contract digests. The existing scalar refusal behavior also lacked a focused regression test.
primary_claim: Sparse tensor scalar identity now normalizes both signs of zero to one canonical 0.0 representation before TensorView ordering and CanonicalContract serialization, while the existing no-implicit-coercion boundary is pinned by focused tests.
gardener_decision: Normalize signed zero at the existing SparseTensorEntry scalar boundary rather than add a numeric wrapper, serializer fork or tensor-value abstraction. Forest and Fourfold remain authoritative and tensor remains a derived computational projection.
acceptance: bool scalar values remain rejected rather than coercing to 0.0 or 1.0
numeric strings remain rejected rather than being parsed implicitly
objects implementing __float__ remain rejected rather than executing arbitrary coercion
integer scalars remain accepted and canonicalize to float
negative zero is stored with a positive sign
+0.0 and -0.0 TensorViews serialize to identical canonical JSON
+0.0 and -0.0 TensorViews have identical contract digests
NaN and infinities remain rejected by the existing finite-number guard

requested: PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python -m pytest -q tests/twin/test_tensor_scalar_contract.py tests/twin/test_tensor_evidence_bounds.py tests/twin/test_tensor_construction_bounds.py tests/twin/test_tensor_kernel.py tests/twin/test_fourfold_contracts.py tests/twin/test_projection_verifier.py
verification.claim: source-level canonicalization plus focused regression preparation only until exact-head executable evidence exists

rollback: Revert the G1-TENSOR-01C commits; canonical Forest/Fourfold artifacts and their identities are unchanged.
